The film title “Dark Star Breakout” appears in bold sans-serif type, horizontally centered within the bottom 15% safe area, in high-contrast bright white with subtle outer glow, ensuring no cropping under a 2.39:1 theatrical mask and fully avoiding the protagonist’s face and weapons.
